finding.title: Stop surfacing e.toString() as user-facing error text in BulkMarkScreen; route through AppErrorView/l10n
finding.why: When BulkPriorCompletionService.execute() throws for any reason, the raw Dart exception's toString() renders directly in the confirmation-phase error banner shown mid-onboarding — untranslated, implementation-detail text like 'Exception: Network error'. onboarding_bulk_l1_test.dart's 'error in execute stays on confirmation with error text' test asserts this raw string as correct, so the anti-pattern is regression-protected instead of caught. bulk_mark_screen.dart already imports AppErrorView (line 11) but doesn't use it here — this is exactly the pattern the (currently non-functional) no_e_to_string_in_ui custom lint targets.
finding.recommendation: Catch the specific exception types execute() can throw, map them to AppLocalizations-resolved messages (or AppErrorView), and update the test to assert the localized string instead of the exception's toString().
acceptance_criteria: onboarding_bulk_l1_test.dart's error-path test asserts an AppLocalizations-sourced string, verified in both Locale('en') and Locale('he'), not a literal 'Exception: ...' substring
Once custom_lint's analyzer version pin is fixed, dart run custom_lint reports no no_e_to_string_in_ui violations in bulk_mark_screen.dart
